review_summary: Round 4 proves the manual visual loop works, but the features sit on a still-blocky face and several major forms are missing or too weak: eye whites/socket volume, cheek/nose planes, the blue end of the hanging cloth, a continuous olive shoulder shadow, and a brighter collar. Add only those visually necessary corrections.

actions.intent: reduce the remaining hard capsule boundaries across the face
actions.decision: The facial planes still read as separate horizontal bars. A second, slightly stronger local Mixer pass is justified before adding more linework.

actions.intent: make the nearer eye read as an eyeball inside the lid marks
actions.decision: The current eye is only a dark cross. Add a restrained off-white oval under the lid, not a bright white symbol.

actions.intent: make the farther eye read as a softly lit eyeball
actions.decision: The farther eye needs a small off-white mass, slightly larger than the pupil but still subdued by the socket shadow.

actions.intent: seat the farther eye inside the darker socket instead of leaving it as a floating line
actions.decision: The reference has a noticeably darker socket around the farther eye. Add a tiny soft shadow patch around it, not eyelashes.

actions.intent: turn the nose tip without outlining it
actions.decision: The nose line is too skeletal. Add a very small warm shadow mass around the tip/nostril so the line becomes volume.

actions.intent: restore a continuous warm cheek plane between eye, nose and jaw
actions.decision: The face needs one broad cheek light to connect the features. This is more valuable than adding any new contour line.

actions.intent: give the mouth a lower-lip volume instead of two equal red lines
actions.decision: A single lighter red stroke on the lower lip is enough; do not draw teeth or a full lip outline.

actions.intent: make the pearl read as a large soft hanging form rather than a tiny white mark
actions.decision: The pearl is currently too small. Add a few cool-gray volume strokes around the existing highlight, keeping the highlight count unchanged.

actions.intent: connect the yellow crown to the blue wrap so the turban reads as one object
actions.decision: A dark gap separates the yellow crown from the blue band. Fill that structural gap with a few mid-ochre strokes; folds can wait.

actions.intent: add the conspicuous blue lower end of the hanging cloth
actions.decision: The reference has a pale-blue end wrapping the bottom of the hanging cloth. This is a major missing color mass, not decorative detail.

actions.intent: turn the upper jacket shadow into one continuous olive passage
actions.decision: The upper-right jacket shadow still reads as several dark vertical bars. Repaint it as a broader olive mass with overlapping strokes.

actions.intent: restore the collar as a clean bright separator between face and jacket
actions.decision: The collar is still dull and fragmented. Add a small number of brighter strokes along its existing wedge instead of widening it.
